page.overview:
What is Bell Tower?

The Bell Tower, titled Tin Tower in the Generation II games, is a tall building in Ecruteak City in Johto. The player is required to have the Rainbow Wing to access the Bell Tower in and the remakes , allowing them them and some Kimono Girls to summon a level 40 Ho-Oh, at a stronger level 70 in and .

In , the Clear Bell is also required because it summons Suicune at the first floor of the Tin Tower. However, the player can get Ho-Oh to appear if they have caught the three Legendary Beasts and entered the Hall of Fame; the former methods cannot be worked around if receiving each of the Legendary Beasts through trading.

In the Generation IV remakes, if the player does not capture Ho-Oh on the first encounter, they are given another chance to after entering the Hall of Fame. Additionally, the remakes show a Rattata in the location preview, on the top right during morning and on the left side during the day and evening, while showing a Gastly during the night instead.
